title: "Release notes"
subtitle: "convinterp"
jupyter: python3
---

The notes of every release, as published on
[GitHub](https://github.com/NikoBiele/convinterp/releases), newest first. The wheels of each
release are on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/convinterp/), and each release is archived on
Zenodo under its own DOI; the citation file in the repository has the details.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import json, re, urllib.request

REPO = "NikoBiele/convinterp"                                # the repository whose releases are listed

def demote(body):
    """Push a release body's headings below the page's own, leaving code blocks alone."""
    out, in_fence = [], False
    for line in body.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("```"):                           # a fence line opens or closes a code block
            in_fence = not in_fence
        if not in_fence and re.match(r"^#+ ", line):         # a heading outside code blocks
            line = "##" + line                               # "## Highlights" becomes "#### Highlights"
        out.append(line)
    return "\n".join(out)

def absolute_links(body):
    """Point relative links, which GitHub resolves inside the repository, at the repository."""
    blob = f"https://github.com/{REPO}/blob/main/"
    return re.sub(r"\]\((?!https?://|#|mailto:)", "](" + blob, body)

url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases?per_page=100"
request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"})
releases = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(request))      # newest first, as GitHub orders them

for release in releases:
    tag = release["tag_name"]
    date = release["published_at"][:10]                      # the day, from the ISO timestamp
    print(f"## [{tag}]({release['html_url']}) — {date}\n")
    print(demote(absolute_links((release["body"] or "").replace("\r\n", "\n"))))
    print()
```
